title: Susan Gough by Kirkpatrick's side at George Mason event

tellings.quote: I met Kirk Patrick in person and I was there at that incident and she was attached at his hip would not leave.

plain: At a 2023 event at George Mason University in Virginia, the Pentagon spokesperson Susan Gough reportedly never left the side of Sean Kirkpatrick, then head of the Pentagon's UFO office. The defense writer Marik von Rennenkampff says he was there and met Kirkpatrick, and that Gough "was attached at his hip, would not leave." He tells it to suggest the Pentagon was keeping a close watch on what Kirkpatrick said.
